# Diagnose failed production DB credential rotation without reading or printing credentials.
---
TYPE: WORKFLOW_DISPATCH
COMMAND_ID: cmd-20260908-092000-prod-credential-rotation-diagnostic-v2
STATUS: PENDING
WORKFLOW: remote-operator.yml
REF: main
TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 10
INPUTS_JSON: {"operation":"command","mode":"sync","timeout_minutes":"10","workdir":"/opt/madworld","command":"set -euo pipefail; echo ROTATION_DIAG_START; echo deployed_sha=$(cat .github-deployed-sha); echo env_keys=$(grep -E ^(POSTGRES_USER|POSTGRES_DB|MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL)= .env | cut -d= -f1 | paste -sd,); echo db_url_present=$(grep -q ^MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL= .env && echo yes || echo no); echo db_user_present=$(grep -q ^POSTGRES_USER= .env && echo yes || echo no); echo db_name_present=$(grep -q ^POSTGRES_DB= .env && echo yes || echo no); echo postgres_container=$(docker inspect madworld-postgres-1 --format {{.State.Status}} 2>/dev/null || echo missing); echo disk=$(df -Pm /opt/madworld | tail -1 | awk {print $4}MB_free); echo backup_files=$(find backups -maxdepth 1 -type f -name madworld-*.dump | wc -l); db_user=$(grep ^POSTGRES_USER= .env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-); db_name=$(grep ^POSTGRES_DB= .env | head -1 | cut -d= -f2-); db_user=${db_user:-madworld}; db_name=${db_name:-madworld_db}; echo db_probe; docker exec madworld-postgres-1 psql -U $db_user -d $db_name -Atqc SELECT\ datname\ FROM\ pg_database\ WHERE\ datistemplate=false\ ORDER\ BY\ datname; echo ROTATION_DIAG_DONE"}
---
